language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the band's words. auto follows the Claude desktop app's display language in the desktop Code tab, and elsewhere Claude Code's own language setting, then the locale; English with neither. Languages other than Japanese and English are translated once by a small model call (haiku) and kept. ja or en fixes it. The weather names stay English.
